post.topic: Automated lead nurturing for coaching institutes
post.headline: Boost *Enrollments* with AI Follow‑Up
post.subline: AI bot sends personalized WhatsApp messages, nudging prospects to book a free session.
post.caption:
💡 Want more students without extra sales staff?
Our AI bot turned cold inquiries into booked discovery calls in 48 hours.
How? It captures every lead from your website, qualifies them, and sends a tailored WhatsApp reminder with a calendar link.
Practical tip: Set up a simple Zap that adds new form entries to a WhatsApp template and watch responses rise.
Save this post and share it with a fellow coach who needs more enrollments.
DM "AUTOMATE" for a free 15‑min call
post.insight_note: Coaching institutes are seeking scalable ways to convert leads during enrollment peaks.
